title: We exhaust ourselves trying to present a polished, doubt-free version of Christianity to God.
paragraphs: We exhaust ourselves trying to present a polished, doubt-free version of Christianity to God. We think He demands perfection. We are terrified that if we question, stumble, or feel weak, we’ve failed.
Here is the liberating truth: God doesn’t need your performance. He wants your presence.
He isn't looking for a flawless faith that never wavers. He’s looking for the grit to keep showing up at His feet, even when you're hurting, confused, or doubting.
The most powerful faith isn't the one that never gets knocked down; it's the one that refuses to stay down. Even if you have to crawl back to Him, just keep moving toward the Light.
Don't quit. Your mustard seed is enough.
📖 The ultimate prayer of imperfect faith: “Immediately the boy’s father exclaimed, ‘I do believe; help me overcome my unbelief!’” — Mark 9:24 (NIV)
